description:
hey yo! something different for you. 

Following on from concept EP "AH-FREE-KA" this time Marc Mac homes in on the Jamaican dance music influence in Broken Beat. Broken Beat, much like Jungle coming out of London soaked up the surrounding cultures and became a musical reflection of those cultures. JA-MAYE-KA is a sample of that energy that radiates from the fusion of styles and culture. The mixture of Afro-Latin Electro drums, dub style mix-downs and heavy bass-lines result in another instant BRUK floor filler, not for the faint hearted. We Broken Beat is stripped down like this... RAW... we call it BRUK. Another left-of-centre experience from the 4hero pioneer. 
JA-MAYE-KA aka Yardstyle Electro Boogie.

Artwork by Mitchy Bwoy is the icing on this musical biscuit. Available on limited edition 12" vinyl and digital. Global distribution by Kudos.

Produced By Marc Mac
Mixed in the Shed 
Written By M. Clair (Clair Ways / Westbury Music)

*please note, only a limited amount of vinyl will be sold through Bandcamp, the remaining stock through Kudos Distribution.
